threads.Author: codex
threads.Text: [Q] Dogfood confirms deterministic creation and role-scoped loading are useful. The remaining judgment is rollout: keep this repo bundle as the default example now, or require more cross-project evidence?

Anchor.selected_text: - Default adoption is complete. After cross-project use, keep the standard folder map or revise the taxonomy?
Anchor.context_after: - Do these findings justify a follow-up plan for richer context ranking, or is deterministic navigation sufficient for now?

Replies.Author: codex
Replies.Text: Adopted: comments new now initializes the standard OKF bundle by default; the docs will treat opt-out/migration as compatibility, not the primary path.
